Title: FUN's Cross-Word Puzzle
Author: T. W. Martin, Jr.
Copyright: New York World
Date: 1914-08-02
Number: 30
Description: A zigzag W of 3-wide stepped bands, 8 rows by 31 columns: two peaks of three squares in the top row, a valley of three in the middle of the bottom row, and three-square ends at bottom left and bottom right; every word is two or three letters.
Source: Milwaukee Sentinel, 1914-08-02, p. 69
